comments.body: Its sailing ability was improved for the cost of battle-related stats such as durability and armour. If you're looking for a Golden Hind-type ship that's improved for battle, look into Shadow Hind.

comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
@ DiNozzzo, IMO this is one of the very best for light combat/BH. It's got a great skillset for it, plus great base armour for accel.

No, this is not a battle ship in the traditional sense. It's not going to have 40 base armour and 1400 dura no matter what. But use your imagination and picture the possibilities of something this fast with that skillset. It goes 9/9 too!

I once had one with EA/RSM/APN/HB, max dura/sail/armour/WR with 30 turn and near max crew at -25%. I fought 1v3 vs. some (admittedly scrubby) pirates in it, all of whom called their aides, and I killed all 6 ships. In the hands of someone who knows how to use it, this ship is super versatile and deadly.
